warnings.headline: Yellow warning for ice snow in Belgium - Antwerp
warnings.description: The ground may become slippery due to: 1 to 5 cm fresh snow in 6 hours, or 5 to 10 cm fresh snow in 24 hours, or (very) local black ice, or (very) local frost or ice patches. Be careful.

warnings.headline: Moderate avalanches warning
warnings.description: Moderate damages may occur, especially in vulnerable or in exposed areas and to people who carry out weather-related activities.
warnings.instruction: Be careful, keep informed of the latest weather forecast.

warnings.headline: Severe rain-flood warning
warnings.description: Heavy rain likely to impact human activities is expected. Due to rainfall, visibility may be reduced, floods are possible. Road traffic conditions may be difficult and some disruptions may affect rail travel.
warnings.instruction: I keep away from rivers and low points, I reach a high point or I take shelter upstairs. I do not drive on a flooded road, even if it is only partially so. I avoid travelling. I keep myself informed and stay aware of the rising waters. I don't go into basements. I keep my belongings out of the water and locate my emergency kit.
